moments.text: Zoomed infrared view of rippled sea: four pale blurred shapes, three close together and one apart, cross from the left edge to the right.
The video cuts through a few high-contrast and dark frames.
Wider view with a crosshair: three small white shapes in a tight row and a fourth below-left move slowly together across the sea.
A box closes on the row of three with a 29M-33M readout; then a 92M readout appears and the shapes show as pale dashes.
The view follows the group over the sea as zoom and contrast change; black masking blocks cover the left edge at times.
The picture breaks into blocky black-and-grey glitches, then clears with the group near the crosshair.
Black and noisy frames as the video cuts.
A harsh edge-filtered view of choppy sea: the group shows as faint pale clusters drifting across while sensor symbols smear.
The footage from 0:08 replays with flatter contrast and no glitches: the row of three plus one moves across the sea.
After a grey and black frame, a grainy close-up with a bright patch: a small pale elongated shape, sometimes two or three pieces, drifts across.
Single green, blue and dark-blue frames flash as the video cuts.
A heavily filtered, noisy black-and-white view of the sea; the shapes are barely visible as faint pale specks.
After a black frame, a smoother view: one bright shape with a dark outline moves from the upper left toward the centre over the water.

notes: Uploader-edited compilation. 4:00-5:55 repeats 0:08-2:03 (different contrast, no glitches). Official '06:09-06:50 zoom in' corresponds to the close-up from 5:56 here.
